title: Zainab ne jisko paala
body:
zainab ne jisko paala noori hijab may
wo qatl hogaya hai ehde shabab may
haye akbar haye akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ki laash dekhi to shabbir ne kaha
sughra ko kya likhunga khat ke jawab may
haye akbar haye akbar...
zainab ne jisko paala…
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime se nikle akbar to sabko gumaan hua
sarwar ho jaise baithe zeene ukhaab may
haye akbar haye akbar...
zainab ne jisko paala…
<<DIVIDER>>
usko bhi zaalimon ne hai naize pe chadaya
jee bhar ke jo na khela goday rubab may
haye akbar haye akbar...
zainab ne jisko paala…
<<DIVIDER>>
matam ka mas'ala hai ye humse na poochiye
sab khuch likha hua hai ummul kitaab may
haye akbar haye akbar...
zainab ne jisko paala…
<<DIVIDER>>
tapka lahoo jo ban may shabbir ka ameer
ubhra wo aaj ban kar shakle gulaab may
haye akbar haye akbar...
zainab ne jisko paala…
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
